description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Change where a timer sits on the Timers tab (`up` or `down`, one place, the way ⋯ → Move up / Move down does) or add a ready, not-started copy of it directly below (`duplicate`: "Pasta" becomes "Pasta 2", same time, steps, flip settings and alert; no run, meal or link). A dish of a meal moves only inside its own meal, and not once the meal is under way.

action.description: up / down — one place; duplicate — a copy directly below.
